goal: Create scripts/factory/emit.mjs — the never-throwing emitter facade plus the run sidecar (<stateDir>/ledger/run.json) that owns run identity, the phase cursor, caller-allocated seq ranges, per-gate attempt counters, heartbeat cadence, the billed accumulator, the per-dispatch resolution map, and the drop counters. This slice ships the primitives only (openRun/startRun/endRun/phaseTransition/reserveSeq/updateSidecar/emit/bumpGateAttempt/mapSignalLogEntries/stats/installFinalizer); the call sites that use them land in be-41-03..06. Nothing imports this module yet, so the slice is inert by construction. Two properties must be proven, not described: (a) instrumentation is never load-bearing — a throwing or degraded ledger handle changes no caller outcome, exit code, or returned value; (b) the seq-allocation lock discipline — reserve a range inside a tiny critical section, persist it before any emission, release before any ledger I/O, with a bounded lock wait and a counted give-up.
constraints: ADR-024/ADR-026 clause 1 (instrumentation is never load-bearing): every public method on the returned emitter is wrapped so no throw escapes; a failure increments a drop counter and writes AT MOST ONE stderr line for the whole process lifetime. ledger.mjs deliberately throws when its JSONL append fails ('losing the raw record is fatal to the caller', ledger.mjs:11-13) — this facade swallows that.

ADR-027 (lock discipline): the critical section contains NO sqlite, NO JSONL, NO spawn — read sidecar, allocate a seq range, bump reserved_through, atomic write (writeFileSync(tmp) + linkSync), release. All ledger I/O happens after release, passing an explicit seq drawn from the reserved range. The reservation is persisted BEFORE any emission (a crash mid-batch leaves a gap, never a duplicate). State at the allocation site, in a comment, that seq is MONOTONE, NOT GAPLESS, and why that is safe (listEvents pages by id, ledger.mjs:1131; dumpTable orders by natural key, ledger.mjs:1148) so a later reader does not 'repair' the gaps.

conventions.md 2026-08-02 (concurrency-unsafe check-then-act): exclusive create is writeFileSync(tmp)+linkSync (EEXIST = loser); the lock file is created with flag 'wx' carrying {pid, started_at}; a corrupt or unparseable lock is STALE and is broken, never a wedge. existsSync-then-rename is always a TOCTOU.

Lock waiting is BOUNDED, always: a fixed retry budget (20 x 50ms ~= 1s) then a give-up that increments stats.lock_giveups, drops that emission, and logs at most one stderr line per process. An unbounded instrumentation lock IS instrumentation becoming load-bearing.

conventions.md 2026-08-08 (scoped Node floor / zero-skip): scripts/factory/* runs on the Node >= 24 floor; the below-floor path must be exercised on every matrix leg by a SEPARATE zero-skip test file, not by a whole-file skip. Reach below-floor behaviour through the injected-version seam openLedger({nodeVersion}) (ledger.mjs:490-496), never by probing process.versions.

conventions.md 2026-08-08 (source-text needles): any source-text assertion builds its needle from fragments (['a','b'].join('')) and the scanned file is authored to avoid the bare token in its own comments.

#40 written obligation (config.md:63): never sweep or write ~/.dev-team/factory/. Every test db path comes from DEVTEAM_LEDGER_DB / DEVTEAM_LEDGER_DIR over a real mkdtempSync dir — never ':memory:', never defaultDbPath().
defaultDbPath() (ledger.mjs:1344-1348) is CLI-ONLY. A library path must never call it — db_path travels in the sidecar. Pin this with a source-text assertion (fragment-built needle).
conventions.md 2026-08-01: this repo has no typecheck or lint tooling (plain JS + node:test), so validation is the filtered test run only.
conventions.md 2026-08-01: every functional commit bumps .claude-plugin/plugin.json's version and the commit message ends with '; bump 0.<major>.<minor>' — 0.1.77 -> 0.1.78 here.

acceptance_criteria: SIDECAR CREATE IS EXCLUSIVE: two concurrent openRun calls against the same stateDir produce exactly one sidecar file and one adw_id; the loser adopts the winner's file (EEXIST from linkSync is the adopt signal, never an error). Test in test/factory-emit.test.mjs.

SEQ RESERVATION UNDER CONCURRENCY: a concurrency fixture races TWO independent emitters (two handles and, for at least one case, two real child processes) allocating from one (adw_id, kind) space and asserts (a) every allocated seq value is unique across both, and (b) EVERY row survives in the mirror — not merely that the first writer's rows did. Test in test/factory-emit.test.mjs.

BELOW-FLOOR COLLISION IS COVERED EXPLICITLY: with the injected below-floor nodeVersion (so ledger.mjs's nextSeq seeds max=0 deterministically, ledger.mjs:624-643), two emitters still produce non-colliding seq values and no dropped JSONL line — i.e. the parent-side allocator, not MAX(seq), is what prevents the deterministic 100% below-floor collision. Assertions live in the zero-skip test/factory-emit-floor.test.mjs and run on every CI matrix leg (no skip token anywhere in that file, pinned by a fragment-built source-text needle).

PERSIST-BEFORE-EMIT: a test that makes the ledger emission throw AFTER a reservation was taken asserts the sidecar's reserved_through has already advanced on disk, and that the next reservation returns strictly higher values (a gap, never a repeat).

BOUNDED LOCK WAIT + COUNTED GIVE-UP: with a pre-planted, non-stale lock file held for longer than the retry budget, the emitter returns within the budget (assert elapsed < 3s with an injected clock or a real bound), increments stats.lock_giveups by exactly 1, drops that emission, writes at most ONE stderr line, and the calling code still receives its normal return value. A pre-planted CORRUPT (unparseable) or over-age lock is broken and stolen instead, and the emission succeeds.

NEVER LOAD-BEARING — MUTATION TEST (not inspection): a test injects a ledger handle whose every writer THROWS (and, separately, a degraded handle) and asserts that (a) no method of the emitter throws, (b) each method's return value is byte-identical (deepEqual) to the healthy-handle case for every non-stats field, (c) stats().dropped is incremented by exactly the number of failed emissions, and (d) exactly one stderr line was written. This criterion is only met if REMOVING the facade's try/catch makes the test fail — the coder must verify that by temporarily removing it and re-running.

READABLE COUNTERS (5.2b): stats() returns {emitted, dropped, lock_giveups, resolution_ambiguous, resolution_missing, payload_keys_dropped}; every mutation flushes them into the sidecar's stats object in the same write that persists seq; statsSnapshot() returns the terminal snapshot object be-41-04's teardown emits as a log-typed event with level 'warn' iff any drop counter is non-zero. Asserted in test/factory-emit.test.mjs.

IDEMPOTENT PHASE TRANSITION: calling phaseTransition('building') twice in a row (across two separate emitter instances reading the same sidecar, mirroring two dispatch.mjs processes) produces exactly ONE building phase row — the second call is a no-op, not a second endPhase/startPhase pair.

EXPLICIT NULL, NEVER OMISSION: phase_id is passed as explicit null when startPhase returned null (degraded mode, ledger.mjs:746-765); context_window and transcript_path are explicit null where unknown. requireFields only rejects undefined (ledger.mjs:645-655), so an omitted key is a refusal and a null is legal — asserted for the degraded path.

NO KNOWN-DROPPED PAYLOAD KEY: a test asserts that for every event type this module emits, the payload keys are a subset of PAYLOAD_KEYS[type] (ledger.mjs:89-101), so ledger.stats().dropped_payload_keys stays a defect signal rather than noise.

C5 MAPPER: mapSignalLogEntries() implements the SignalLogEntry contract in interface_contract verbatim — a non-string message is DROPPED and counted (never .slice()d), the level is clamped against the caller-supplied level array, the message is control-character-stripped AND capped at the caller-supplied max, and nothing else from the entry is forwarded. Tested with a hostile fixture entry (non-string message, unknown level, embedded ANSI/newline, 5000-char message) in test/factory-emit.test.mjs.

LIBRARY PURITY: importing scripts/factory/emit.mjs performs no I/O, opens no file, and installs no signal handler (mirrors ledger.mjs:34-41); installFinalizer is opt-in and is NOT installed by openRun.

DEEP REVIEW REQUIRED: scripts/factory/*.mjs is deep-review class (config.md:48). This spec must be gated by dev-team:code-reviewer-deep plus a dev-team:test-engineer mutation pass (the #61 protocol, as run at #40) — the test-engineer owns hypothesising and verifying mutations beyond the ones named above (lock-steal threshold, reservation-range exhaustion, stats flush removal).

interface_contract:
PRODUCED HERE; be-41-03, be-41-04, be-41-05 and be-41-06 consume these verbatim and must not redefine them.

=== RUN SIDECAR — <stateDir>/ledger/run.json ===
{ adw_id, repo_slug, task_slug, db_path, jsonl_path, created_at,
  phase: {name, seq, phase_id, started_at},
  seq: { event: {next, reserved_through}, phase: {next, reserved_through} },
  gate_attempts: {"<gate_name>": n},
  heartbeats: {"<claude_session_id>": iso},
  billed: {input, output, cache_write, cache_read},
  stats: {emitted, dropped, lock_giveups, resolution_ambiguous, resolution_missing, payload_keys_dropped},
  dispatches: {"<dispatch_id>": {claude_session_id, transcript_path|null, session_started: bool, sighted_at|null}} }
Created link-exclusive (writeFileSync(tmp)+linkSync; EEXIST = adopt the existing run). Every mutation is a locked RMW: 'wx' lock file {pid, started_at}, corrupt or over-age lock = stale and stolen, atomic tmp+linkSync write, release. NO sqlite, NO JSONL, NO spawn inside the critical section.

=== EMITTER FACADE (scripts/factory/emit.mjs) ===
openRun({stateDir, repoSlug, taskSlug, dbPath?, nodeVersion?, now?, stderr?}) -> emitter   // creates or adopts the sidecar; never throws
emitter.adwId -> string
emitter.sidecar() -> object                      // read-only snapshot, no lock
emitter.startRun() -> void                       // startSession + startPhase('planning'); idempotent
emitter.phaseTransition(name) -> {phase_id|null} // endPhase(prev)+startPhase(name); a no-op when already in `name`
emitter.reserveSeq(kind, n) -> number[]          // kind: 'event'|'phase'; [] on lock give-up; persisted before return
emitter.updateSidecar(patchFn) -> boolean        // locked RMW for dispatches/heartbeats/billed; false on give-up
emitter.bumpGateAttempt(gateName) -> number      // 1-based, inside the critical section; 0 on give-up
emitter.emit(fn) -> boolean                      // opens a handle, runs fn(handle, nextSeq), closes; swallows every throw, counts, returns false on failure
emitter.mapSignalLogEntries(entries, {levels, messageMaxChars}) -> [{level, message}]
emitter.endRun({status}) -> void                 // endPhase(open) + endSession with the sidecar's billed_* accumulator
emitter.stats() -> {emitted, dropped, lock_giveups, resolution_ambiguous, resolution_missing, payload_keys_dropped}
emitter.statsSnapshot() -> {level:'info'|'warn', message}  // the log-typed terminal snapshot event teardown emits
emitter.installFinalizer() -> void               // opt-in; only awaitCmd calls it (be-41-04)
emitter.dispose() -> void
EVERY method is never-throwing. Every emission passes an explicit seq. status is one of SESSION_STATUSES; 'fail' is DELIBERATELY unreachable from a normal endRun — it is reserved for ledger.mjs's finalizer, the only writer that can honestly claim the run died (ADR-027).

=== C5 — SignalLogEntry (mapSignalLogEntries' contract) ===
relaySignals().recorded is NOT a validated stream: ladder.mjs:711-717 pushes schema-INVALID parsed objects into `recorded` (and into `dropped`) and continues; only malformed JSON is excluded (:707). The SIGNAL_LEVELS clamp (:719) and the SIGNAL_LIMITS.message_max_chars cap (:741) apply to the RELAY path only. Every `recorded` entry therefore passes through this mapping before becoming a `log` event, inside the never-throw facade:
1. typeof entry?.message !== 'string' -> DROP and count. (Do NOT .slice() a non-string: inside a never-throw facade that becomes a silently swallowed TypeError that eats the whole batch.)
2. level = levels.includes(entry.level) ? entry.level : 'progress' — mirroring ladder.mjs:719 exactly, one shared constant, never a second enum (the array is passed in by the caller).
3. message = control-characters stripped, THEN capped at messageMaxChars (200, the same constant ladder.mjs:741 uses), applied on the `recorded` path too. Strip AND cap: sanitization bounds content, capping bounds volume, and each is a distinct surface (conventions.md 2026-08-08).
4. Nothing else from the entry is forwarded (PAYLOAD_KEYS.log is ['level','message']).
5. The relay side effect is NEVER performed. Asserted by counting notify invocations in the fake-cmux log (must be zero), not by intent.
